## Getting to Know Siba Vitamin: The Brand Behind a Project I’ve Been Working On

I’ve shared some of my experience building Siba Vitamin’s website, but this time I want to talk about the business behind it. This project is personal to me because it started with helping my sister. She was working on her vitamins and supplements business, and I got involved on the website side. That gave me a chance to learn more about what she wanted to build while developing my own skills.

Usually, I talk about themes, menus, product pages, and all the little things that can go wrong on a website. But behind those pages, there’s a person putting time and effort into an idea. So I thought it was time to introduce Siba Vitamin itself.

### How Siba Vitamin Started

Siba Vitamin is managed by Siba Nutraceutical LLC. My sister started the brand because she wanted to help people take better care of themselves and support their everyday wellness. Her goal was to offer supplements that people could explore as part of their daily routines. That idea became the starting point for the business, and she has been working on developing it step by step.

Being involved has shown me how much work happens behind an online store. There are products to organize, information to explain, customer questions to answer, and decisions to make as the business grows. I help with the technical side, but the purpose behind the brand comes from her.

### What Does Siba Vitamin Offer?

Siba Vitamin sells dietary supplements through its online store. The range includes capsules, gummies, softgels, and resin, as well as bundles that bring selected products together. Some products feature botanical ingredients such as ashwagandha, moringa, turmeric, and black maca. Others include mushroom ingredients such as cordyceps, nutrients such as magnesium, or fish oil containing omega-3 fatty acids. There are also combination formulas for people who want to explore several ingredients in one product.

I want to keep this introduction simple. You don’t need to understand every technical term to start looking around, but it helps to know what a product contains and where to find more information.

### Getting Familiar With the Ingredients

One thing I’ve noticed while working on the store is that recognizing a product name doesn’t always mean you know what’s inside it. Ashwagandha, for example, is a botanical ingredient offered in both capsule and gummy formats. Moringa is another plant ingredient in the range, while the cordyceps product uses a mushroom ingredient. Other options include magnesium glycinate and omega-3 fish oil. The omega-3 product contains EPA and DHA, which are types of omega-3 fatty acids.

Some formulas combine several ingredients. The sea moss complex, for example, includes sea moss alongside black seed oil, ashwagandha, turmeric, and black pepper. These products are different from one another. I wouldn’t assume that everyone needs the same supplement or that two products with similar names have the same formula. For me, the sensible starting point is to read the information, understand what you’re looking at, and ask questions when something isn’t clear.

### Where Is Siba Vitamin Based?

Siba Nutraceutical LLC lists its business location in West Palm Beach, Florida, in the United States. The business currently sells online, so customers can browse the products and place orders through the website. [Siba Vitamin contact information](https://sibavitamin.com/pages/contact)

Siba Vitamin is also working on expanding into Colombia. That’s another step in the business’s development, and I’m looking forward to seeing how it grows. If you’re interested in ordering from Colombia or another country, contact the team to confirm current delivery availability.

### A Few Questions You Might Have

**What kind of supplements does Siba Vitamin sell?**

The store offers a mix of botanical supplements, mushroom supplements, minerals, fish oil, and combination formulas. There are several formats to explore, including capsules, gummies, softgels, and resin.

**Do all the products contain the same ingredients?**

No. Each product has its own formula. Some focus on one main ingredient, while others combine several. Check the specific product information rather than assuming it’s the same as something you’ve used before.

**Can I choose between capsules and gummies?**

Some ingredients are available in different formats. Ashwagandha is one example in the current range. You can check the catalog to see which options are available.

**Are all Siba Vitamin products vegan?**

It depends on the product. The range includes different ingredients and capsule types, and fish oil products are not vegan. Check each product’s details if you have dietary preferences or restrictions.

**How do I know which product is right for me?**

Start by reading the ingredients, directions, and precautions. If you’re unsure, especially if you take medication or have a health condition, speak with a qualified healthcare professional before using a supplement. This article is an introduction to the business, not personal health advice. Supplements do not replace a varied diet or medical care.

**Does Siba Vitamin have a physical store?**

The business currently sells online. You can explore the products through the website and contact the team with questions about products or orders.

**Can customers in Colombia order?**

The business is working on expanding into Colombia. Contact the team for the latest information about availability and delivery there.

### My Part in the Project

My involvement has mainly been on the website and technical side. I’ve worked on the Shopify theme, the way the products are presented, navigation, mobile layouts, and the details that help people use the store. Sometimes that means building a section or adjusting a product page. Other times, it means opening the website on my phone and thinking, “Okay, that looked better on my computer. Let’s fix it.”

### There’s always something to check.

Working on Siba Vitamin has reminded me that a website needs to do more than look good. People need to find the products, read the information, and understand what to do next. I’m still learning through that process. It has given me a real business to work with, real problems to solve, and a reason to keep improving. And because it’s my sister’s business, it means something to me beyond finishing another website.

### What I Want to Share Going Forward

I’d like to keep sharing what happens behind projects like this: the work, the questions, the mistakes, and the things we improve along the way. This article is a first introduction to Siba Vitamin. It gives you a little background on who manages the brand, what it offers, and how I became involved. If you’re curious, visit [sibavitamin.com](https://sibavitamin.com/) to explore the products and learn more about the business.

Now, when I mention working on Siba Vitamin’s website, you’ll know a little more about the people and purpose behind it.

Written by Javier Sibauste.
